title: Sony Music Publishing & GIC close $3.5B–$4B acquisition of Recognition Music Group (Hipgnosis)

signal_snapshot.summary: Sony Music Publishing, via a joint venture with Singapore sovereign wealth fund GIC, closed its landmark $3.5B–$4.0B acquisition of Recognition Music Group (formerly Hipgnosis Songs Fund, managed by Blackstone), covering 45,000+ songs.
samples: Music Business Worldwide: Sony Music Publishing & GIC close $3.5B–$4B Recognition Music Group deal

question: Classify the primary IP/commercial catalyst (catalog_revival, licensing_merch, ma_deal, brand_partnership, or rights_risk) and explain the rights-holder and commercial valuation implications.

ground_truth.label: ma_deal
ground_truth.rationale: Confirmed M&A close: Sony Music Publishing and GIC closed the $3.5B-$4B acquisition of Recognition Music Group's 45,000+ song catalog.
